test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 1 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: An amount becomes eight-fifth of the original amount in 5 years at what percentage rate of simple interest per annum?
solution: Given: Time = 5 years Amount = (8)/(5) principal Formula used: Simple interest = (Principal × rate × time)/100 Amount = Principal + Simple Interest
